Class ApplicationsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApplicationsController
@RequestMapping("/api/applications") @RestController public class ApplicationsController extends ApiController
An applicant's own applications.

Every read and write here confirms the row belongs to the current user. An applicant reading or editing someone else's application would be the worst bug this iteration could ship, so ownership is checked explicitly rather than relying on a query happening to filter by email.

    • requireCourseworkLengths

      public static void requireCourseworkLengths(ApplicationsController.ApplicationFields fields)
      The length rule for every save path, drafts included (issue #323): a value longer than its column is refused with a clear message, never truncated. Lengths are those of the value as it would be stored, that is, without surrounding spaces.
